text:
Predicates:
Spring(x) ::: x is Spring.
Summer(x) ::: x is Summer.
Fall(x) ::: x is Fall.
Winter(x) ::: x is Winter.
Season(x) ::: x is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
LongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ LongVacation(x) → FavoriteSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(mia, x) ↔ ¬FavoriteSeason(emma, x) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
Student(james) ∧ LongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
